Who we are

About Namahmi School of Skills

A cloud-based, AI-powered learning ecosystem for professionals moving into Product Management, Program Management, AI and digital leadership roles — founded by Shobhit Shubham Saxena on one belief: skills create opportunities, execution creates impact.

The approach

AI-first isn't a module. It's the default.

Most training bolts AI on at the end. We start there. Every track assumes AI is already a working teammate, then builds the judgment, process and craft to use it well — so you don't just learn tools, you change how the work gets done.

Who we are

About Namahmi School of Skills

Namahmi School of Skills (NSOS) is a cloud-based, AI-powered learning ecosystem built for ambitious professionals who aspire to transition into Product Management, Program Management, AI, and Digital Leadership roles.

Founded by Shobhit Shubham Saxena, a visionary AI Product and Program Leader with over a decade of experience building and scaling products across India's leading startups and enterprises, NSOS was born from a simple belief:

Skills create opportunities. Execution creates impact.

Throughout his 10+ year journey, Shobhit has contributed to the growth of world-class startups, witnessed companies enter the Unicorn Club, and led strategic initiatives across E-Commerce, Payments, Banking, MarTech, EdTech, and AI-driven products. Having navigated multiple Zero-to-One product journeys, he understands the exact skills, mindset, and execution capabilities required to thrive in today's rapidly evolving digital economy.

At NSOS, we are redefining professional education through an AI-enabled learning experience that combines industry expertise, real-world projects, product thinking, leadership development, and emerging technologies.

Our programs are designed for

  • Aspiring Product Managers
  • Program Managers
  • Business Analysts
  • Engineers transitioning into Product roles
  • Working professionals seeking career acceleration
  • Entrepreneurs building the next generation of digital businesses

Unlike traditional learning platforms, NSOS focuses on practical execution, real business problems, and industry-ready outcomes. We believe that learning should not stop at theory — it should empower individuals to build, launch, scale, and lead.

Our Vision

To become India's most trusted AI-powered School of Skills, enabling millions of learners to transform their careers through practical, industry-relevant education.

Our Mission

To bridge the gap between education and employability by delivering world-class learning experiences, mentorship, and AI-driven career transformation programs.

Our Philosophy
